body: Widens `compile_template_guide` to accept an optional `study_context`. One real contract gap; otherwise clean.

comments.body:
The new `study_context` arg changes output but isn't part of the cache key, so two different contexts collide on a stale cached guide.

<details>
<summary>Instructions for AI Agents</summary>

Include `study_context` (or a stable hash of it) in the cache key for `compile_template_guide`.

</details>

Missing docstring on the widened signature.

<details>
<summary>Instructions for AI Agents</summary>

Add a docstring documenting the optional `study_context` parameter.

</details>
